# <span id="aanchor107"></span> Gain/Loss Balance Tool

The FLOWCAL dashboard includes a Gain/Loss Balance widget to help you keep track of location gain/loss balances.

By default, a single widget will display on the dashboard, using the preferred location set on the [User Preferences](../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md) screen.

Two views are available within the widget:

- **Table view** shows the actual value of the data
- **Graphical view** shows the percentage gain or loss for the location, with an upper and lower bound of 2 and -2, respectively

Click the widget to toggle between views.

Click the **More** link in the bottom right corner of the widget to open the Rollups Viewer. Click the **Refresh** button to update the data in the widget.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 785;height: 245;" />

## Data Types

The data displayed in the Gain/Loss Balance widget varies based on the fluid phase of the location:

- **Gas Location** - Volume, energy, mass
- **Liquid Location** - NSV, mass
- **Gas and Liquid Location** - Volume, energy, mass (gas), NSV, mass (liquid)

For gas or liquid locations, the Gain/Loss Balance widget defaults to the table view. You can click the widget to see the graphical view.

For mixed locations (locations that are both gas and liquid), the initial table view will display values for gas and liquid. When you click the widget, the graphical view will display the gas data. When you click the widget again, the graphical view will display the liquid data.

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Add/Remove">

You can display up to four Gain/Loss Balance widgets on the dashboard.

<div class="procedure">

To add or remove a Gain/Loss Balance widget:

1.  Click the gear icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> in the top right corner of the main screen to open the Settings menu.
2.  Click **Dashboard Manager**.
3.  Click **Gain/Loss Balance**.
4.  Click the "X" icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" /> to remove the widget from your dashboard, or click the **Add a new widget** link to add a new widget.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 624;height: 358;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Configure">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Configure a Gain/Loss Balance widget</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Configure">

Using the Dashboard Manager, you can specify the system and location associated with a Gain/Loss Balance widget.

<div class="procedure">

To set up a Gain/Loss Balance widget:

1.  Click the gear icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> in the top right corner of the main screen to open the Settings menu.
2.  Click **Dashboard Manager**.
3.  Click **Gain/Loss Balance**.
4.  Add a new widget if necessary.
5.  Click the **System** and **Location** fields to select a system and location for your widget. You can also begin typing in these fields to search for a name.
6.  Select a unit of measure for the balance data.

</div>
